title: Public pet page shows owner, created date, and ID
summary: The public Shelter pet page now shows the owner, the created date, and the record ID. It does not add case or clinic links for this role.
changes: Show owner, created date (UK dd/mm/yyyy), and record ID on the Shelter pet page.
Keep case and clinic records off this page so service users are not sent to links that refuse them.
version_rationale: Patch release: adds missing owner, created date, and ID on the public pet page without changing permissions or adding new navigation.
validation: PHPUnit PublicShelterPetPageTest covers owner, created date, and ID on the public Shelter pet page, escaped owner markup, and no case or clinic links when related records exist.
php artisan myapes:changelog-validate --base-ref=origin/main on the PR branch.
known_limitations: The Pet Care clinic pet page is unchanged and still does not show owner, created date, or ID.
rollback: Redeploy the previous application version to hide owner, created date, and ID on the Shelter pet page again.
provenance: Public Shelter pet page owner, created date, and ID for issue #151, pull request #202.
